parameters.name: IsPoc
parameters.description: Specifies whether the service is a trial.

parameters.name: NetworkRegionId
parameters.description: The region of the virtual network.

parameters.name: PrivateVpcConnectionMode
parameters.description: The connection mode. Valid values: \`PrivateLink\` and \`OverlayLink\`. \`OverlayLink\` is an overlay link based on Application-aware Network Service Mesh (ANSM).

parameters.name: ServiceInstanceEndpointServiceType
parameters.description: The direction of the internal-facing access. Valid values: \`Forward\` and \`Reverse\`.

parameters.name: ServiceRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the service is located.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The zone for the service deployment.
